title: Operator norm bounded by the Hilbert–Schmidt norm
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every (continuous) linear map A : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (Lean: A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P; every linear map on ℝ^P is continuous) and every v ∈ ℝ^P: |Av|² ≤ (Σ_{i=1}^{P} |A e_i|²)·|v|², where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 is the standard basis; equivalently the operator norm is bounded by the Hilbert–Schmidt norm, ‖A‖ ≤ |A| := (Σ_i |A e_i|²)^{1/2}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (v : Euclid P), ‖A v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i : Fin P, ‖A (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖ ^ 2
